summary.text: Azure Duan is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 50 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Michelle Au (D).
She works in healthcare and says she is a clinician, small business owner and first-generation immigrant running on cost of living, public safety and education.

paragraphs.text: Azure Duan earned a bachelor's degree from Minnesota State University, Mankato in 1997, a graduate degree from the University of Minnesota in 2000, and a Ph.D. from Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine in 2009.
Her career experience includes working in healthcare.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mom, clinician, small business owner and first-generation immigrant who is not a career politician.
Duan said she would work to lower the cost of living through property and state income tax relief, support police officers and firefighters, and favor curriculum transparency and school choice.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
